title: Pure Koala
summary: Chumley Huffington's Koala archetype combines burn-and-control EARTH Beasts (Des Koala, Sea Koala, Vampiric Koala, and Koalo-Koala) with the 4200 ATK Fusion boss Master of Oz ('Big Koala' + 'Des Kangaroo'). Use Rescue Cat to Special Summon two Level 2 Beasts (Sea Koala + Tree Otter) from your Deck—reducing an opposing monster's ATK to 0 with Sea Koala, boosting another Beast by 1000 ATK with Tree Otter, and fusing into Koalo-Koala to destroy an opponent's monster—while Fusion Deployment and King of the Swamp effortlessly summon Master of Oz!

allow.Rescue Cat: Tributes itself to Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast monsters (Sea Koala, Des Koala, or Tree Otter) directly from your Deck—immediately assembling Rank 2 Beasts!
allow.Obedience Schooled: Limited to 1 in TCG: if you control no monsters, Special Summons 3 Level 2 or lower Beast Effect Monsters with different names from your Deck.
allow.Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest: Level 2 EARTH Beast Tuner summoned alongside Sea Koala and Tree Otter by Obedience Schooled that discards 1 card to revive Sea Koala or Des Koala in Attack or face-down Defense Position.
allow.King of the Swamp: Substitutes for Big Koala or Des Kangaroo to Fusion Summon Master of Oz or Koalo-Koala, OR discards itself to search Polymerization.
allow.Fusion Deployment: Reveals Master of Oz or Koalo-Koala in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, or Sea Koala directly from your hand or Deck!
allow.Polymerization: Fuses Big Koala + Des Kangaroo into the 4200 ATK Master of Oz, or Sea Koala + Tree Otter into Koalo-Koala.
allow.Ayers Rock Sunrise: Chumley's signature Beast revival Spell that Special Summons any Beast monster from your GY and weakens opposing monsters by 200 ATK per Beast in your GY.
allow.Melffy of the Forest: Rank 2 EARTH Beast Xyz made with Sea Koala + Tree Otter that searches a Beast monster or negates an opposing monster.
allow.Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu: Rank 2 EARTH Beast Xyz made with two Level 2 Beasts that summons a Beast Token copying the highest ATK on the field.

main: Sea Koala

Core Level 2 EARTH Beast: once per turn while you control another Beast monster, targets 1 monster your opponent controls and reduces its ATK to 0 until the End Phase; also the named Fusion Material for Koalo-Koala!
Des Koala
Chumley's signature Level 3 DARK Beast Flip monster (1800 DEF) that inflicts 400 burn damage to your opponent for each card in their hand when flipped face-up.
Big Koala
Level 7 EARTH Beast Normal Monster with 2700 ATK / 2000 DEF; summoned directly from the Deck via Fusion Deployment and serves as the named Fusion Material for Master of Oz.
Des Kangaroo
Level 4 DARK Beast (1500 ATK / 1700 DEF) that destroys any monster that attacks it with lower ATK than its DEF, and serves as the named Fusion Material for Master of Oz.
Tree Otter
Level 2 WATER Beast that gives another Beast monster +1000 ATK while you control another Beast, and is the second named Fusion Material for Koalo-Koala!
Vampiric Koala
Level 4 EARTH Beast (1800 ATK) that gains LP equal to the battle damage it inflicts to your opponent when battling a monster.
Rescue Cat
Sends itself to the GY to Special Summon Sea Koala + Tree Otter from your Deck—reducing an opponent's monster to 0 ATK with Sea Koala and boosting by 1000 ATK with Tree Otter!
Obedience Schooled
Limited to 1 in TCG: summons Sea Koala, Tree Otter, and Valerifawn directly from the Deck to assemble Rank 2 Beasts or tribute/fuse under its Beast-only lock.
Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest
Level 2 EARTH Beast summoned by Obedience Schooled that revives Sea Koala or sets Des Koala face-down from your GY.
King of the Swamp
Substitutes for Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, Sea Koala, or Tree Otter, or discards itself to search Polymerization.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Master of Oz or Koalo-Koala in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, Sea Koala, or Tree Otter directly from your Deck!
Polymerization
Fuses Big Koala + Des Kangaroo into Master of Oz, or Sea Koala + Tree Otter into Koalo-Koala.
Ayers Rock Sunrise
Revives Master of Oz, Koalo-Koala, Big Koala, or Sea Koala from your GY and drops all opponent's monsters' ATK.
extra: Signature Level 9 EARTH Beast Fusion boss ('Big Koala' + 'Des Kangaroo') with a massive 4200 ATK / 3700 DEF—crushing any monster reduced to 0 ATK by Sea Koala for 4200 battle damage in a single hit!
Signature Level 6 EARTH Beast Fusion boss ('Sea Koala' + 'Tree Otter'; 2800 ATK): sends 1 Beast monster from your hand to the GY to target 1 monster your opponent controls and destroy it.
Rank 2 EARTH Beast Xyz (2 Level 2 Beast monsters): cannot be destroyed while you control another Beast, and detaches 1 material to summon a Token copying the highest ATK on the field.
Rank 2 EARTH Beast Xyz made with Sea Koala + Tree Otter that searches a Beast monster or negates an opposing monster.
